hooks.compiled:
overflow: hidden;
  transition: max-height 0.25s ease, opacity 0.25s ease;

border-color: var(--ab-base-accent-hover);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ab-base-accent) 5%, transparent);

border-color: var(--ab-base-accent);
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ab-base-accent) 15%, transparent);

border-left-color: var(--ab-danger, #dd0000);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ab-danger, #dd0000) 8%, #f9f9f9);

text-decoration-style: solid;
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ab-base-accent) 10%, transparent);
